items.title: Bloom Energy Just Dropped 12% in a Week. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?

items.title: Microsoft (MSFT) Is Pulling Back From Key Neocloud Data Center Deals
items.summary: Microsoft (NasdaqGS:MSFT) is winding down several neocloud data center capacity deals, including a non-renewal of its Oracle arrangement. The company is exiting relationships with operators such as Nscale and IREN, reducing outsourced capacity tied to neocloud hubs. Management is refocusing on more flexible, in-house data centers as regulators, cost pressures, sustainability rules, and anti-AI protests reshape project economics. items.title: Goldman raises global data center capacity forecast to 273 GW by 2030
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs raised its forecast for global data center capacity to 273 gigawatts by 2030 from 217 gigawatts previously, citing stronger artificial intelligence infrastructure demand and expectations for further project announcements.
